profiles.name: Adam Adli Abd Halim
profiles.description: Adam Adli Abd Halim represents Hang Tuah Jaya, Melaka, in the Dewan Rakyat. Current role: Deputy Minister of Higher Education. A PKR member.

profiles.name: Khoo Poay Tiong
profiles.description: Khoo Poay Tiong represents Kota Melaka, Melaka, in the Dewan Rakyat. A DAP member.

profiles.name: Zulkifli Ismail
profiles.description: Zulkifli Ismail represents Jasin, Melaka, in the Dewan Rakyat. A PAS member.

milestones.title: Hold an open MOHE dialogue with Liga Mahasiswa Malaysia
milestones.description: Adam Adli said a substantive student dialogue was being organised and was expected by May at the latest.
milestones.progress_note: A 17 June follow-up says discussions would continue and his office would contact LMM. This does not confirm that the originally scheduled dialogue happened. The May target uses an end-of-month marker.

milestones.title: Hand over a TNB MeSRa home in the Portuguese Settlement
milestones.description: Khoo officiated the 3 October handover of a RM98,000 home built under TNB’s corporate social-responsibility programme, with household equipment also provided.
milestones.progress_note: Achieved covers this home handover with TNB. The source was published after midnight on 4 October. It is not the MP’s sole construction delivery or a whole-constituency housing score.
